new.tovw: Lead grade F: the pot was found and removed by the family in Jan 1897 (local weekly, two issues plus the probate contest); nothing reported left
new.n: John Koci's quart pot of $20 gold pieces in his cellar, Manitowoc (found 1897)
new.pl: Manitowoc city; the house lot is not yet found
new.st: John Koci, 77, of Manitowoc city, father-in-law of John Reindl, died suddenly in the first week of January 1897. The family's search of his cellar turned up a pot 'which would contain about a quart, filled with 20 dollar gold pieces'; no one had known where it was hidden. In Sept 1897 Judge Anderson heard a contest over the property of the man 'in whose cellar a pot of gold was found', turning on an ante-nuptial agreement. The pot was taken up in 1897; nothing more is reported. Pin is the city, not the house.
new.t: Recovered 1897; a city lot, address not yet found (1897 Manitowoc directory). Urban: look only; the lesson is the cellar.
src: Manitowoc Pilot, 7 Jan 1897, p. 3, death notice (Newspapers.com 900611663)
